author: VivekGRamaswamy
text: I’m joining state lawmakers in the morning to publicly lay out a legislative plan to suspend the Ohio gas tax immediately. While Amy Acton posts consultant-crafted statements & tries desperate political stunts, we’re taking real action to improve lives now.
